== Biography ==
{{Nebraska Sticker}}
John was born 18 Jun1836 in Brush Creek, Adams County, Ohio to [[Glasgow-1829|Joseph Glasgow]] and [[Black-18588|Margaret Black]]. <ref>John M Glasgow in the U.S., Veterans' Gravesites, ca.1775-2019</ref>

By 1856, he had moved to Des Moines Township, Jefferson County, Iowa.<ref>Iowa, U.S., State Census Collection, 1836-1925 for John M Glasgow</ref>

On 2 Jul 1861 he married [[Rose-19881]] in Washington County, Iowa.<ref>Iowa, U.S., Marriage Records, 1880-1947 for John M Glasgow</ref>

John and Ann had six children.

Dr Glasgow died on 30 March 1901 in Omaha, Douglas, Nebraska.<ref>John M. Glasgow in the Directory of Deceased American Physicians, 1804-1929</ref>

He is buried in Laurel Hill Cemetery in Omaha, Nebraska.<ref>Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/19473597/john_marshall-glasgow: accessed March 16, 2024), memorial page for Corp John Marshall Glasgow (18 Jun 1836–30 Mar 1901), Find a Grave Memorial ID 19473597, citing Laurel Hill Cemetery, Omaha, Douglas County, Nebraska, USA; Maintained by SRGF (contributor 47487065).</ref>
